examples.text_en: She gave a convincing reason for the sudden change.
examples.text_zh: 她为这次突然的改变给出了令人信服的理由。

examples.text_en: His story was so convincing that everyone believed him.
examples.text_zh: 他的故事如此令人信服，以至于每个人都相信了他。

examples.text_en: The dinner was warm and convivial from the start.
examples.text_zh: 晚餐从一开始就温暖而欢乐。

examples.text_en: They spent a convivial night with old friends.
examples.text_zh: 他们和朋友们度过了一个欢乐的夜晚。

examples.text_en: The whole room was full of good food and conviviality.
examples.text_zh: 整个房间满是美食和欢乐的气氛。

examples.text_en: A night of conviviality left us all very happy.
examples.text_zh: 一个欢乐的夜晚让我们都非常开心。

examples.text_en: The leader will convoke a meeting for next week.
examples.text_zh: 领导人将在下周召集一次会议。

examples.text_en: They decided to convoke the whole group at once.
examples.text_zh: 他们决定立刻召集整个小组。

examples.text_en: The story was too convoluted for the young children.
examples.text_zh: 这个故事对孩子们来说太复杂了。

examples.text_en: His explanation was long and rather convoluted.
examples.text_zh: 他的解释又长又相当复杂。

examples.text_en: The trucks moved in a long convoy to the city.
examples.text_zh: 卡车组成长长的车队驶向城市。

examples.text_en: A convoy of ships left the town at night.
examples.text_zh: 一队船只在夜里离开了小镇。

examples.text_en: The bad news seemed to convulse the whole room.
examples.text_zh: 这个坏消息似乎震撼了满屋的人。

examples.text_en: A great laugh can convulse a whole crowd.
examples.text_zh: 一阵大笑可以使整个人群笑得前仰后合。

examples.text_en: The news sent a convulsion through the whole town.
examples.text_zh: 这个消息在整座城镇引起了震动。

examples.text_en: His body was caught in a sudden convulsion.
examples.text_zh: 他的身体突然抽搐起来。

examples.text_en: The small birds were kept in a wooden coop.
examples.text_zh: 这些小鸡被关在一个木制鸡笼里。

examples.text_en: The old coop was too small for the hens.
examples.text_zh: 这个旧鸡笼对母鸡来说太小了。

examples.text_en: Please write the coordinate of each point.
examples.text_zh: 请写出每个点的坐标。

examples.text_en: The map shows the coordinate of the old house.
examples.text_zh: 地图上标出了那座老房子的坐标。

examples.text_en: The coordinated work of the team was very smooth.
examples.text_zh: 团队协调一致的工作非常顺利。

examples.text_en: Their coordinated efforts brought the project to an end.
examples.text_zh: 他们协调一致的努力使项目得以完成。

examples.text_en: Good coordination between the teams made the work easy.
examples.text_zh: 各队之间良好的协调使工作变得轻松。

examples.text_en: The job needs care and a lot of coordination.
examples.text_zh: 这项工作需要细心和大量的协调。

examples.text_en: She took copious notes during the long talk.
examples.text_zh: 在那场长谈中，她记了大量的笔记。

examples.text_en: The garden gave a copious amount of food.
examples.text_zh: 这座花园产出了大量的食物。

examples.text_en: The doctor gave him a cordial to help him rest.
examples.text_zh: 医生给他一种补品，帮助他休息。

examples.text_en: He took a warm cordial before the long walk.
examples.text_zh: 长途步行前他喝了一杯温热的补品。

examples.text_en: This cordless phone works well in the whole house.
examples.text_zh: 这部无绳电话在整个房子里都能用得很好。

examples.text_en: They bought a cordless tool for the small job.
examples.text_zh: 他们为这项小活买了一件无绳工具。

examples.text_en: He pulled the cork from the old bottle.
examples.text_zh: 他从旧瓶子上拔出了软木塞。

examples.text_en: The cork kept the water in the glass bottle.
examples.text_zh: 软木塞把水留在了玻璃瓶里。

examples.text_en: The young man plays a cornet in the town band.
examples.text_zh: 这个年轻人在镇上的乐队里吹短号。

examples.text_en: She put the candy in a paper cornet.
examples.text_zh: 她把糖果装进了一个纸做的圆锥形纸袋里。

examples.text_en: A line of birds sat on the cornice of the old house.
examples.text_zh: 一排鸟落在老房子的檐口上。

examples.text_en: The cornice along the top of the wall was white.
examples.text_zh: 墙顶的檐口是白色的。

examples.text_en: The market was a cornucopia of fresh food and fruit.
examples.text_zh: 这个市场是新鲜食物和水果的一大丰收之源。

examples.text_en: She saw a cornucopia of gold and bright colors.
examples.text_zh: 她看到了丰盛的金色和鲜艳的色彩。

examples.text_en: His corny joke made the children laugh anyway.
examples.text_zh: 他那个老土的玩笑还是让孩子们笑了。

examples.text_en: The old song sounds corny to young people today.
examples.text_zh: 这首老歌在今天年轻人听来很俗气。

examples.text_en: The coronation of the new queen took a whole day.
examples.text_zh: 新女王的加冕礼花了整整一天。

examples.text_en: Many people came to watch the coronation in the city.
examples.text_zh: 许多人来到城里观看加冕典礼。

examples.text_en: The corporal gave the order to his small group.
examples.text_zh: 下士向他的小组下达了命令。

examples.text_en: A young corporal led the men up the hill.
examples.text_zh: 一位年轻的下士带领士兵们上了山。

examples.text_en: The soul is not a corporeal thing.
examples.text_zh: 灵魂不是有形之物。

examples.text_en: We live in a corporeal world of real things.
examples.text_zh: 我们生活在一个由真实事物构成的有形世界里。

examples.text_en: The whole corps moved to the south at night.
examples.text_zh: 整个军团在夜里向南进发。

examples.text_en: He joined a small corps of brave men.
examples.text_zh: 他加入了一支由勇敢的人组成的小部队。

examples.text_en: The corpulent man could not walk very far.
examples.text_zh: 这个肥胖的人走不了很远。

examples.text_en: A corpulent body made the old chair bend.
examples.text_zh: 肥胖的身躯把那把旧椅子压弯了。

examples.text_en: The corpus of old songs is very large.
examples.text_zh: 这些老歌的语料库非常庞大。

examples.text_en: They built a corpus of English words for study.
examples.text_zh: 他们为学习建立了一个英语词语语料库。

examples.text_en: A red corpuscle carries air through the blood.
examples.text_zh: 红细胞在血液中输送氧气。

examples.text_en: The doctor looked at each corpuscle under the glass.
examples.text_zh: 医生在玻璃片下观察每一个血球。

examples.text_en: They kept the horses in a wooden corral.
examples.text_zh: 他们把马关在一个木制畜栏里。

examples.text_en: The corral was near the river and the old house.
examples.text_zh: 畜栏在河边和老房子附近。

examples.text_en: Each correlate gave us a clue about the cause.
examples.text_zh: 每一个相关的事物都给了我们关于起因的线索。

examples.text_en: The scientist found a correlate of the same illness.
examples.text_zh: 科学家发现了同一种疾病的一个相关因素。

examples.text_en: The two sets of numbers are clearly correlated.
examples.text_zh: 这两组数字明显相关。

examples.text_en: Good health and good food are closely correlated.
examples.text_zh: 健康和良好的饮食密切相关。

examples.text_en: The correspondence between the two events is clear.
examples.text_zh: 这两件事之间的对应关系很清楚。

examples.text_en: She kept all her correspondence in a small box.
examples.text_zh: 她把自己所有的信件都保存在一个小盒子里。

examples.text_en: The correspondent sent a report from the far city.
examples.text_zh: 这位通讯记者从远方那座城市发回了报道。

examples.text_en: A good correspondent writes to her friend every week.
examples.text_zh: 一个喜欢写信的人每周都给朋友写信。

examples.text_en: The two forms have corresponding parts on each side.
examples.text_zh: 这两种形式在每一侧都有相对应的部分。

examples.text_en: Each number has a corresponding letter in the book.
examples.text_zh: 在书中，每个数字都对应一个字母。

examples.text_en: The new facts corroborate the story of the witness.
examples.text_zh: 新的事实证实了证人的说法。

examples.text_en: He could not corroborate his own claim in court.
examples.text_zh: 他无法在法庭上证实自己的说法。

examples.text_en: Salt water will corrode the old metal gate.
examples.text_zh: 盐水会腐蚀旧金属大门。

examples.text_en: Time can corrode even the strongest of things.
examples.text_zh: 时间甚至能侵蚀最坚固的东西。

examples.text_en: The corrosion on the old car was easy to see.
examples.text_zh: 那辆旧车上的锈迹很容易看出来。

examples.text_en: Good paint can stop the corrosion of the metal.
examples.text_zh: 好的油漆能阻止金属腐蚀。

examples.text_en: This corrosive water can eat through the metal.
examples.text_zh: 这种腐蚀性的水能蚀穿金属。

examples.text_en: Keep corrosive things away from the children.
examples.text_zh: 让腐蚀性物品远离孩子们。

examples.text_en: The machine will corrugate the flat sheets of metal.
examples.text_zh: 这台机器会把平的金属板压成波纹。

examples.text_en: Heat can corrugate the thin surface of the road.
examples.text_zh: 高温会使路面的薄层起皱。

examples.text_en: The roof was made of cheap corrugated metal.
examples.text_zh: 屋顶是用便宜的波纹金属做的。

examples.text_en: They put corrugated paper on the old wall.
examples.text_zh: 他们把波纹纸贴在了旧墙上。

examples.text_en: The lights coruscate across the whole night sky.
examples.text_zh: 灯光闪烁在整片夜空上。

examples.text_en: Her eyes seemed to coruscate with real joy.
examples.text_zh: 她的眼睛似乎闪烁着真正的喜悦。

examples.text_en: The cosmic rays come from far beyond our world.
examples.text_zh: 宇宙射线来自我们世界之外的远方。

examples.text_en: They studied the cosmic dust for many long years.
examples.text_zh: 他们研究宇宙尘埃许多年。

examples.text_en: The city is cosmopolitan and full of many cultures.
examples.text_zh: 这座城市具有世界性，充满了多种文化。

examples.text_en: He had a cosmopolitan view of the whole world.
examples.text_zh: 他对整个世界持一种世界主义的观点。

examples.text_en: Cosmopolitanism is common in large cities and ports.
examples.text_zh: 世界主义在大城市和港口很常见。

examples.text_en: He wrote about cosmopolitanism and its place in history.
examples.text_zh: 他撰文论述世界主义及其在历史中的位置。

examples.text_en: The little cosset slept in a warm box by the fire.
examples.text_zh: 那只小宠物睡在炉边一个温暖的盒子里。

examples.text_en: She keeps a cosset as a friend and a joy.
examples.text_zh: 她养了一只宠物作为伙伴和乐趣。

examples.text_en: The small room was cosy and full of light.
examples.text_zh: 这个小房间温暖舒适，光线充足。

examples.text_en: They made a cosy home near the old school.
examples.text_zh: 他们在老学校附近安了一个舒适的家。

examples.text_en: The soldier slept on a cot in the small room.
examples.text_zh: 士兵睡在小房间里的一张行军床上。

examples.text_en: We put a cot near the door for the guest.
examples.text_zh: 我们在门边为客人放了一张小床。

examples.text_en: A small coterie ran the whole club.
examples.text_zh: 一个小圈子掌控着整个俱乐部。

examples.text_en: She joined a coterie of writers in the city.
examples.text_zh: 她加入了城里一个作家的小圈子。

examples.text_en: The two countries are coterminous along the long river.
examples.text_zh: 这两个国家沿着这条长河边界相连。

examples.text_en: Their land is coterminous with the wide plain.
examples.text_zh: 他们的土地与那片广阔的平原相连。

examples.text_en: A tall cottonwood grew beside the old house.
examples.text_zh: 一棵高大的三角叶杨长在老房子旁边。

examples.text_en: The cottonwood lost all its leaves in the fall.
examples.text_zh: 这棵三角叶杨在秋天落光了叶子。

examples.text_en: A cougar was seen near the small town at night.
examples.text_zh: 有人看见一只美洲狮夜里出现在小镇附近。

examples.text_en: The cougar ran fast through the dark wood.
examples.text_zh: 美洲狮飞快地穿过黑暗的树林。

examples.text_en: She gave me good counsel before the big test.
examples.text_zh: 大考之前她给了我很好的忠告。

examples.text_en: The counsel for the man spoke to the court.
examples.text_zh: 这名男子的法律顾问向法庭作了陈述。

examples.text_en: She went to counseling after the loss of her job.
examples.text_zh: 失业之后她去接受了心理咨询。

examples.text_en: The school offers counseling to young people in need.
examples.text_zh: 学校为有需要的年轻人提供咨询服务。

examples.text_en: The counselor helped the child talk about his fear.
examples.text_zh: 顾问帮助这个孩子说出自己的恐惧。

examples.text_en: She works as a counselor at the local school.
examples.text_zh: 她在当地的学校做顾问。

examples.text_en: His countenance showed no sign of fear.
examples.text_zh: 他的面容没有流露出丝毫恐惧。

examples.text_en: Her calm countenance gave us all great hope.
examples.text_zh: 她平静的面容给了我们大家很大的希望。

examples.text_en: Good food can counteract the bad effects of stress.
examples.text_zh: 良好的饮食能抵消压力的不良影响。

examples.text_en: They acted fast to counteract the poison.
examples.text_zh: 他们迅速行动以中和毒素。

examples.text_en: They put heavy stones to counterbalance the light load.
examples.text_zh: 他们放上重石来平衡较轻的一边。

examples.text_en: One strong win can counterbalance several small losses.
examples.text_zh: 一场大胜可以抵消几次小败。

examples.text_en: Turn the key counterclockwise to open the old door.
examples.text_zh: 把钥匙按逆时针方向转动来打开这扇旧门。

examples.text_en: The wheel turned counterclockwise in the strong wind.
examples.text_zh: 轮子在强风中逆时针转动。

examples.text_en: The police found counterfeit money in the old car.
examples.text_zh: 警方在那辆旧车里发现了假币。

examples.text_en: This watch is a cheap counterfeit, not real gold.
examples.text_zh: 这块表是廉价的赝品，不是真金。

examples.text_en: The leader had to countermand his first order.
examples.text_zh: 领导人不得不撤回他最初的命令。

examples.text_en: They will countermand the plan to build the road.
examples.text_zh: 他们将取消修建这条路的计划。

examples.text_en: The two leaders met their counterpart in the old hall.
examples.text_zh: 两位领导人在旧礼堂会见了各自的对应人物。

examples.text_en: This word has no true counterpart in our language.
examples.text_zh: 这个词在我们的语言里没有真正的对应词。

examples.text_en: They used a large stone to counterpoise the load.
examples.text_zh: 他们用一块大石头来平衡这份重量。

examples.text_en: A good plan can counterpoise the risks we face.
examples.text_zh: 好的计划能抵消我们面临的风险。

examples.text_en: The coup took the whole country by surprise.
examples.text_zh: 这场政变让整个国家措手不及。

examples.text_en: The army led a coup against the old government.
examples.text_zh: 军队发动政变，反对旧政府。

examples.text_en: A courier brought the letter to the old house.
examples.text_zh: 一名信使把信送到了那座老房子。

examples.text_en: The courier rode all night through the cold rain.
examples.text_zh: 信使冒着冷雨骑了一整夜。

examples.text_en: The courteous man held the door for the old woman.
examples.text_zh: 这位有礼貌的男士为老妇人扶着门。

examples.text_en: She was courteous to everyone at the whole party.
examples.text_zh: 她在整个聚会上对每个人都彬彬有礼。

examples.text_en: He courteously gave his seat to the tired woman.
examples.text_zh: 他有礼貌地把座位让给了疲惫的女士。

examples.text_en: She courteously asked us to wait a short time.
examples.text_zh: 她客气地请我们稍等一会儿。

examples.text_en: The old courthouse stands in the middle of town.
examples.text_zh: 那座旧法院矗立在镇中心。

examples.text_en: They went to the courthouse to sign the papers.
examples.text_zh: 他们去法院签署文件。

examples.text_en: The courtly old man spoke with care and grace.
examples.text_zh: 这位有教养的老人言谈举止文雅得体。

examples.text_en: He made a courtly bow before the whole group.
examples.text_zh: 他在众人面前彬彬有礼地鞠了一躬。

examples.text_en: Their courtship lasted two happy years.
examples.text_zh: 他们的恋爱持续了两个幸福的年头。

examples.text_en: He was very shy during the whole courtship.
examples.text_zh: 在整个求爱的过程中他都非常害羞。

examples.text_en: A small boat lay still in the quiet cove.
examples.text_zh: 一条小船静静地停泊在宁静的小湾里。

examples.text_en: We found a warm cove near the old town.
examples.text_zh: 我们在老镇附近发现了一个温暖的小海湾。

examples.text_en: A coven of witches met in the dark wood.
examples.text_zh: 一群女巫在黑暗的树林里聚会。

examples.text_en: The old story tells of a coven and its magic.
examples.text_zh: 这个古老的故事讲述了一群女巫及其魔法。

examples.text_en: The two sides signed a covenant to keep the peace.
examples.text_zh: 双方签署盟约以维持和平。

examples.text_en: They made a covenant with the whole community.
examples.text_zh: 他们与整个社区立下了盟约。

examples.text_en: The news coverage of the game lasted all night.
examples.text_zh: 这场比赛的新闻报道持续了一整夜。

examples.text_en: The insurance gives good coverage for the old house.
examples.text_zh: 这份保险为这座老房子提供了很好的保障。

examples.text_en: They held a covert meeting in the dark room.
examples.text_zh: 他们在暗室里举行了一次秘密会议。

examples.text_en: His covert plan was never known to the group.
examples.text_zh: 他的秘密计划从未被小组知道。

examples.text_en: Many people covet the gold and the power.
examples.text_zh: 许多人都垂涎黄金和权力。

examples.text_en: He began to covet the new car of his friend.
examples.text_zh: 他开始垂涎朋友的那辆新车。

examples.text_en: The covetous man wanted everything he could see.
examples.text_zh: 这个贪婪的人想要他看到的一切。

examples.text_en: She gave him a covetous look at the gold.
examples.text_zh: 她贪婪地看了一眼那些金子。

examples.text_en: The cowboy rode his horse across the wide land.
examples.text_zh: 牛仔骑马穿过广阔的土地。

examples.text_en: A young cowboy sang a song by the fire.
examples.text_zh: 一个年轻的牛仔在火堆旁唱起了歌。

examples.text_en: The dog began to cower at the loud noise.
examples.text_zh: 狗一听到巨响就开始畏缩起来。

examples.text_en: He would cower in fear when the storm came.
examples.text_zh: 暴风雨来临时他会吓得缩成一团。

examples.text_en: The cowhand worked from morning until late at night.
examples.text_zh: 这位牧牛工从早一直干到深夜。

examples.text_en: A good cowhand knows every cow in the group.
examples.text_zh: 一个好的牧牛工认识牛群里的每一头牛。

examples.text_en: She gave a coy smile and looked away.
examples.text_zh: 她腼腆地笑了笑，把目光移开了。

examples.text_en: The coy young man would not say a word.
examples.text_zh: 这个怕羞的年轻人一句话也不肯说。

examples.text_en: He tried to cozen the old woman out of her money.
examples.text_zh: 他试图骗走那位老妇人的钱。

examples.text_en: Do not let them cozen you with sweet words.
examples.text_zh: 不要让他们用甜言蜜语欺骗你。

examples.text_en: His crabbed writing was very hard to read.
examples.text_zh: 他潦草的字迹很难辨认。

examples.text_en: The old man had a crabbed and angry way.
examples.text_zh: 这位老人脾气古怪，动不动就生气。

examples.text_en: The craftspeople made fine chairs from old wood.
examples.text_zh: 这些工匠用旧木料制作了精美的椅子。

examples.text_en: Many craftspeople sold their work in the town market.
examples.text_zh: 许多手艺人在镇上的集市出售自己的作品。

examples.text_en: A lone bird sat on the high crag.
examples.text_zh: 一只孤鸟停在高高的峭壁上。

examples.text_en: They climbed the crag to see the whole town.
examples.text_zh: 他们爬上峭壁，俯瞰整座城镇。

examples.text_en: The doctor studied the cranial bones of the old man.
examples.text_zh: 医生研究了这位老人的颅骨。

examples.text_en: A hard blow can cause cranial damage.
examples.text_zh: 重重的一击会造成颅部损伤。

examples.text_en: He was in a crank mood all day long.
examples.text_zh: 他一整天情绪都很暴躁。

examples.text_en: The old man was crank and hard to please.
examples.text_zh: 这位老人脾气暴躁，很难取悦。

examples.text_en: The baby gets cranky when he is very tired.
examples.text_zh: 这个婴儿很累的时候就会变得烦躁。

examples.text_en: My old car is cranky in the cold morning.
examples.text_zh: 我的旧车在寒冷的早晨很难发动。

examples.text_en: It was a crass joke and no one laughed.
examples.text_zh: 这是一个粗俗的玩笑，没有人笑。

examples.text_en: His crass words hurt the feelings of the group.
examples.text_zh: 他粗鲁的话伤害了大家的感情。

examples.text_en: They put the old books in a wooden crate.
examples.text_zh: 他们把旧书放进了一个木箱。

examples.text_en: The heavy crate was too big for the small car.
examples.text_zh: 这个沉重的板条箱对这辆小车来说太大了。

examples.text_en: He wore a red cravat with his dark coat.
examples.text_zh: 他戴一条红色领带，配他的深色外套。

examples.text_en: The old man tied a cravat around his neck.
examples.text_zh: 老人把一条围巾系在脖子上。

examples.text_en: The craven ran away at the first sign of danger.
examples.text_zh: 这个懦夫一看到危险就逃走了。

examples.text_en: They called him a craven for his bad act.
examples.text_zh: 因为他的恶劣行为，大家称他为懦夫。

examples.text_en: She had a strong craving for sweet food.
examples.text_zh: 她非常想吃甜食。

examples.text_en: His craving for power grew year after year.
examples.text_zh: 他对权力的渴望一年比一年强烈。

examples.text_en: The child drew a big sun with a red crayon.
examples.text_zh: 孩子用红色蜡笔画了一个大太阳。

examples.text_en: She put every crayon back in the small box.
examples.text_zh: 她把每一支蜡笔都放回了小盒子里。

examples.text_en: There was a deep crease in his old shirt.
examples.text_zh: 他的旧衬衫上有一道深深的折痕。

examples.text_en: She used her hand to make a crease in the paper.
examples.text_zh: 她用手在纸上折出一道折痕。

examples.text_en: The news gave credence to his old story.
examples.text_zh: 这则消息使他的旧说法更可信了。

examples.text_en: We should not give credence to such wild claims.
examples.text_zh: 我们不应该相信这种毫无根据的说法。

examples.text_en: He showed his credential at the door of the hall.
examples.text_zh: 他在大厅门口出示了自己的证件。

examples.text_en: A good credential can help you get the job.
examples.text_zh: 一份好的资历证明能帮你得到这份工作。

examples.text_en: The guard asked to see our credentials at the gate.
examples.text_zh: 守卫在门口要求查看我们的证件。

examples.text_en: She has good credentials for the top job.
examples.text_zh: 她具备担任这个最高职位的良好资历。

examples.text_en: The creditor came to the house for his money.
examples.text_zh: 债权人上门来讨他的钱。

examples.text_en: A kind creditor gave him more time to pay.
examples.text_zh: 一位好心的债主给了他更多的时间还钱。

examples.text_en: His credo was to help others and work hard.
examples.text_zh: 他的信条是帮助他人、努力工作。

examples.text_en: The group lives by a simple credo of care.
examples.text_zh: 这个团体遵循着一条简单朴素的信条：关怀他人。

examples.text_en: The credulous man believed every word of the story.
examples.text_zh: 这个轻信的人相信了故事里的每一个字。

examples.text_en: A credulous buyer can lose a lot of money.
examples.text_zh: 轻信的买家可能会损失很多钱。

examples.text_en: People of every creed can live in this city.
examples.text_zh: 各种信仰的人都可以在这座城市里生活。

examples.text_en: He held to his old creed all his life.
examples.text_zh: 他一生都坚守着自己旧的教义。
